cases.title: Dark Mode Toggle Functionality
cases.description: Verify that toggling the dark mode switch ('dark-mode-switch') adds the 'dark-mode' class to the body element when checked, and removes it when unchecked.

cases.title: Loan Amount Valid Input Handling
cases.description: Verify that the loan amount input field ('amount-input') correctly accepts and processes valid numeric input values.

cases.title: Interest Rate Valid Input Acceptance
cases.description: Verify that the interest rate input field ('rate-input') accepts and stores numeric values for calculations.

cases.title: Loan Term Input Handling Across Cases
cases.description: Verify that the loan term input field correctly handles and stores numeric values covering normal, edge, and error cases.

cases.title: Loan Term Slider and Input Synchronization
cases.description: Verify that adjusting the year slider ('year-slider') between 1 and 30 inclusively dynamically updates the years input field ('years-input') to match the current value.

cases.title: Loan Calculation and Formatting with Valid Inputs
cases.description: Verify that clicking the calculate button ('calculate-button') correctly calculates and displays monthly payment, total payment, and total interest using standard formulas and expected text formats.

cases.title: Payment Chart Update on Valid Calculation
cases.description: Verify that the doughnut chart ('payment-chart') updates to display the proportions of principal and interest when a valid calculation is triggered.

cases.title: Calculation Validation Error Alert
cases.description: Verify that clicking the calculate button with zero, missing, or invalid input values prevents calculation and displays an alert with the message 'Please check your numbers'.

analysis.analysis: R-1: Testable behavior: Toggling the dark mode switch ('dark-mode-switch') adds or removes the 'dark-mode' class on the body element. Boundaries: Checked position adds class, unchecked position removes class. Normal path: Click switch to toggle state. Abnormal path: Switch state without proper DOM update. Ambiguities: None. R-2: Testable behavior: Inputting valid numeric values in 'amount-input'. Boundaries: Valid numeric ranges. Normal path: Enter valid amount. Abnormal path: Enter non-numeric or out-of-range values. Ambiguities: Specific numeric range limits not explicitly defined. R-3: Testable behavior: Accepting and storing numeric values in 'rate-input'. Boundaries: Valid numeric rates. Normal path: Enter valid interest rate. Abnormal path: Enter non-numeric values. Ambiguities: Allowed rate bounds not specified. R-4: Testable behavior: Handling and storing numeric values for loan term across normal, edge, and error cases. Boundaries: Min/max term limits. Normal path: Enter standard term. Edge/abnormal paths: Zero, negative, or extremely large values. Ambiguities: Exact error handling mechanisms beyond general validation. R-5: Testable behavior: Adjusting 'year-slider' (data-testid 'year-slider') updates 'years-input' (data-testid 'years-input'). Boundaries: Range 1 to 30 inclusive. Normal path: Move slider within bounds. Edge cases: Slider values 1 and 30. Abnormal path: Slider out-of-bounds manipulation. Ambiguities: None. R-6: Testable behavior: Clicking 'calculate-button' calculates and displays monthly payment, total payment, and total interest using standard formula or 0 interest formula, updating 'monthly-payment', 'total-payment', 'total-interest'. Boundaries: Valid vs invalid/missing inputs, zero interest rate. Normal path: Valid inputs yield correct calculations and text format. Abnormal path: Invalid or missing inputs trigger alert 'Please check your numbers' and prevent calculation. Ambiguities: Definition of 'invalid' input (e.g., negative numbers vs empty fields). R-7: Testable behavior: Clicking 'calculate-button' with valid inputs updates doughnut chart 'payment-chart' with principal and interest proportions. Boundaries: Valid calculation state. Normal path: Chart renders upon valid calculation. Abnormal path: Chart fails to update if inputs are invalid. Ambiguities: Specific chart library implementation details. R-8: Testable behavior: Clicking 'calculate-button' with zero or invalid input values triggers alert with message 'Please check your numbers'. Boundaries: Zero values, invalid numeric formats, empty fields. Normal path: Valid non-zero inputs proceed without alert. Abnormal path: Zero or invalid values display the exact alert message. Ambiguities: Overlaps with R-6 validation logic.
